# R2 job tables (generated by gen/r2gen.py)

Each job: name (set, render_pb_pages P, runner knobs, regtimeline), the exact tool command and the frozen
predictions (quantity = value [hypothesis] label).  The tool is `$T` (~/sgxfive-test-r1), staged programs `$S`, the
work directory `$W`.  `set`: control, heldout, repeat, replicate.  `tables/` is the runner's input; this is a view.
Knobs: `s2` = read CR_EVENT_STATUS2 from the debugfs regs after the reset and after the job; `sweep:G` = the rest of
group G is skipped once a post-job STATUS2 has bit 7 set; `kpoke` = the row pokes pb:11 (only that), `wd:S` = the
runner's watchdog writes the kernel's debugfs reset S seconds after the tool started; every `tri` job carries
`expectdiff`.

## g-t3: 4 jobs, 4 conditions

```
T3 (geometry, Q230): the 1/w of clip-made vertices (vtx_zw.s: z = A x + B, w = C x + D from the
vertex's own x).
Offline model (r2models.predict_zwclip): Sutherland-Hodgman in (x, y, z, w) against z <= w and z
>= -w (a plane runs
only if a vertex crosses it), the strip zigzag, window = 32 + 32 x/w, a made vertex's depth
exactly 1.0 / 0.0.  The made
vertex's stored 1/w by two candidates: HI-w (the reciprocal of the made w, RZ) and HI-rhw (the 1/w
of the two ends
interpolated with the same edge parameter): 0.75 against 0.8205 at w = 0.5x + 1.25.  Originals: RZ
of 1/w.  Frozen per
row: the vertex SET, ORDER, prim words, the 1/w words by position (exact and within one ulp: S1b
saw 0x3f800001 on one
made vertex of two), the made vertices' depth words.  The originals' depth word is T4's clause
(not scored here).
Controls: z-cut-p (w = 1, the T2 model); a group counts only if it holds.  t3-nocut (no clip) is
held out.
```

## g-t4: 8 jobs, 8 conditions

```
T4 (geometry, Q230): the stored depth at w != 1 (vtx_wzclip.s: vtx_wclip plus `mov o2, #Z`; w = W
constant, x and y
scaled by W so the triangle stays the default one).  z/w in (-1, -0.5] makes 0.5 + 0.5 q exact
(Sterbenz) so the word is
a function of q = the stored z/w alone.  Six candidates for q (frozen words per pair, 3 to 4
distinct words a pair):
D1 RN(Z * RZ(1/W)), D2 RZ(Z/W), D3 RN(Z/W), D5 RZ(Z * RZ(1/W)), D6 RN(RN(Z + W)/(2W)) as a depth
directly, D7 RN(Z *
RN(1/W)).  Controls: Z = 0, W = 3 (E754 e3i-w3) and Z = -0.5, W = 1 (cut-p's A); a group counts
only if both hold.
Decision: the one candidate right in 6 of 6; none = the words are recorded and the clause narrows
to one ulp.
```

## g-t5v: 13 jobs, 13 conditions

```
T5 (Q082): a looping vertex program through probe --tri vtxuse (templates/vtx_loop.s: 8
instructions an iteration as
E769's body 8, a RELATIVE backward branch `p1 br -#7`, the loop count carried into the vertex's
depth).  Why relative:
the tool places the vtxuse program at instruction 0x40 of its page and absolute indices count from
the code base (E476), so
the `ba` loops of R1-events landed elsewhere (E770: the pixel loops wrote o0 in 16 of 64 pixels).
Offline (sgx-sim):
tests/test_t5loop.py runs it at five code indices (all give the same z), and the absolute-`ba`
form stops at a non-zero one.
Knob proof: every vertex's stored depth word is 0x3f200000 + N (z = 0.25 + 4N ulp, exact), so a
loop that did not run N
times on EVERY vertex shows (E770's failure mode), as does a branch that fell through (word + 1).
CR_EVENT_STATUS2 (0x0118)
is read from the debugfs regs after the reset (must be 0x400) and after the job.  The sweep (knob
sweep:t5v) stops at the
first length whose post-job STATUS2 has bit 7 (0x80) set: the rest are recorded as skipped.
H-ITER / H-INSTR: set from 55;
H-TIME: monotone, point by the vertex rate; H-NEVER: no length sets it.  Order: t5v-ctl0, n1, n3
(the first backward
branch, before any long loop), then the ladder.  A hang or fault stops the stage (rc 4), the
debugfs reset recovers.
```

## g-c3: 11 jobs, 11 conditions

```
C3 (geometry, Q210): a second target.  R1 measured C = 0x371 at 4096x4096 (raise at P = 0x373,
none at 0x374: the last
raise has thr0 + 0x20 = 0x371).  P* = 0x374; the four cells P* - 2, P*, P* - 0x20, P* + 0x20 at
2048x2048 with the 4096
pair re-run as controls.  H-same: the raise outcome of each 2048 cell is that of the 4096 cell at
the same P (raise iff P - 2
<= 0x371).  H-target: the (P* - 2, P*) pair is on one side of the new limit and the +-0x20 cells
bracket it.  The proposal's
cells reach the first abort only if the 1500-vertex scene needs more than thr0 = 0x352 pages at
2048x2048; the scene's need
scales with the target's area (about 1300 pages at 4096x4096: E704), so they may all be NODATA
(one render, no abort): the
calibration job (P = 0x422) measures the need and the low ladder (raised threshold 0xa0 .. 0x160,
run from the highest down) tests a lower limit if the
second run can reach it.  A void cell = no first abort or the second run not reaching thr0.  The
tool refuses more than 1500
vertices, so the scene cannot be made larger.  Knob proof: 0x0624 = P - 0x22 in the job's own
rows.  The first 2048x2048
job is a context size never run: if the tool or the kernel refuses it the stage stops (rc 4).
```

## g-c2: 9 jobs, 9 conditions

```
C2 (geometry, Q210): decouple the threshold from P by the descriptor poke pb:11 = V (debugfs
kpoke, user decision R2-12, E625's
`--kpoke-render 1:pb:11=V` ran 5 jobs without incident), P = 0x422 throughout, LAST in its
session.  The kernel applies the poke once
to the next render it kicks and drops it; a debugfs reset (before every job) clears anything still
armed.  R1 fixed the limit at
C = 0x371 for the threshold set through the knob: raise iff thr0 + 0x20 <= 0x371.  H-abs: the same
comparison holds for a poked
threshold (V <= 0x351 raises: 0x351 and 0x352 bracket the limit exactly); H-P: the raise is tied
to the knob's P (0x373), so no
poke raises at P = 0x422 (E625's 0x80 raise on the one-triangle scene is evidence against it);
H-rel: the limit follows P (raise at
every V).  Knob proof per job: the first abort's status (0x0658 stretch start) is V; 0x0624's own
reading is recorded.  A hung or
faulted job stops the stage; the runner's watchdog (wd:75) writes the kernel's own debugfs reset
75 s after the tool started and
the stage ends with a reset and a health triangle.
```
